prior_nested_diagnostic.role: Separate nested GPU corrupted-child witness evidence; not repeated by full N3/N4 runs

runner_guard_tests.scope: Full-mode parser phase/topology/cache/fixture/OpenCL checks using actual serialized GPU report fixtures with synthetic aggregate payloads; accepted existing diagnostic artifacts rechecked. No compiler or GPU/proving workload launched.

limitations: Both cases repeat one complete native fixture; they are not the CPU [A,B,A] and [A,B,A,B] workload and do not establish distinct ledger transaction validity.
The complete 91-leaf graph and trusted keys are prepared/verified on CPU before OpenCL initialization; only the new batch merges are GPU proofs.
No matched CPU/GPU speedup, total-compute savings, throughput, cold-start, production, or N8/N16 qualification is established.
Only the recorded NVIDIA RTX 5080 and driver have executed this workload; AMD portability remains unqualified.
Managed GPU peaks exclude untracked driver/display/context allocations and are not total physical VRAM consumption; the 4 GiB context reserve is an admission allowance.
Artifact byte counts include the serialized final public values and proof, excluding the trusted registered key, original statements, and ledger body; they are not transaction or block sizes.

Full N3/N4 GPU runs check 25 public mutations and one final proof-opening mutation each; they do not repeat separately accepted full CPU aggregate-child witness negatives or the nested GPU witness diagnostic.
Successful serial memory fit does not qualify concurrent CUDA/OpenCL proving or arbitrary batch sizes.
path_convention: Evidence paths are relative to the OpenCL worktree root; ../ names the frozen CPU sibling worktree and relative traversal to /tmp names the external read-only audit helpers.

provenance.historical_snapshots: Historical source snapshots are not authoritative for these full runs; use the accepted per-run input_sha256 manifests

independent_review.scope: Full standalone MatRiCT N3/N4 GPU aggregation of one repeated native fixture; CPU graph preparation

qualified_scope.cpu_role: Complete graph/key preparation, native fixture verification, host orchestration, and parent/artifact verification
qualified_scope.gpu_role: Two fresh serial recursive merge proofs for N3 and three for N4; CPU graph preparation is not GPU work

timing_scope.cache_note: A shared source-specific cache may be reused; initial cache state and cold-start latency are not independently qualified by these records
timing_scope.cpu_child_preparation_seconds: Graph lowering/planning, trusted graph/key reconstruction, source-specific cache/proof preparation, and complete graph verification; excludes preceding fixture decode/native verification
timing_scope.merge_seconds: compile_merge, geometry admission, GPU registration/proving, and parent CPU verification; not GPU-only or proof-only duration
timing_scope.runner_wall_seconds: Whole admitted process observation through service cleanup; includes CPU preparation and all verification
